dataset_name: WearBefore synthetic wardrobe grounded fashion SFT
split_method: Deterministic group split by entire synthetic wardrobe scenario; 80/10/10 separately stratified for complete and incomplete wardrobes.
provenance: The original 2,100 synthetic programmatic examples are retained. 24 additional fictional wardrobe comparisons are manually authored and use the Fashionpedia ontology only as an attributed CC BY 4.0 schema reference. No user wardrobe, feedback, Fashionpedia images, image-level annotations, or LLM-generated targets were used. Curated responses are not expert reviewed.
license_note: Rows using external sources carry per-record source_ids/license. No NC-licensed source is used in the training splits. Fashionpedia is used only for its CC BY 4.0 ontology/schema; its images are excluded. Polyvore and DeepFashion are excluded due rights restrictions or unresolved terms. See training/FASHION_DATASET_LICENSE_AUDIT.md.

sources.title: Introduction to Apparel Production Workbook
sources.authors: Laurie M. Apple, University of Arkansas
sources.scope_note: Used for careful handling of garment material and construction attributes; it is not a source of outfit-quality ratings.

sources.title: Dress, Appearance, and Diversity in U.S. Society
sources.authors: Kelly L. Reddy-Best, Abbey K. Elder, Lesya Hassall, Iowa State University
sources.scope_note: Used for the social and cultural context of dress. Do not turn a population-level discussion into assumptions about an individual user's identity or event requirements.

sources.title: Fashionpedia: Ontology, Segmentation, and an Attribute Localization Dataset
sources.authors: Menglin Jia, Mengyun Shi, Mikhail Sirotenko, Yin Cui, Claire Cardie, Bharath Hariharan, Hartwig Adam, Serge Belongie
sources.license: CC BY 4.0 (ontology and annotations only; images have separate third-party terms)
sources.scope_note: Used only as a cited source for the structure of garment categories, parts, and visual-attribute fields. No Fashionpedia images or per-image annotations are included. The ontology itself has an explicit CC BY 4.0 grant; image rights are separate.

sources.title: WearBefore original styling heuristics
sources.scope_note: Original non-empirical heuristics. They are not expert-reviewed standards or universal fashion laws.

quality_checks.wardrobe_id_constraint: Every selected_item_ids value is drawn from that record's available_wardrobe; incomplete outfit scenarios return an empty list.

limitations: Synthetic supervision does not substitute for designer or user review.
Item/colour/fabric combinations are fictional; responses teach conservative heuristics, not outfit quality rankings.
The 2,000 target is a corpus size target, not evidence of accuracy or generalization.
